title: Toddler in Headscarf Feeding Ducks at Pond, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century square black-and-white snapshot capturing a young toddler sitting beside the edge of a tranquil park pond, tossing bits of bread to swimming ducks. The child wears a light-colored tied headscarf or babushka, a warm two-piece play suit, and light socks and shoes. A paved or dirt path winds along the grassy slope behind the child, with dense bushes, trees, and the faint outline of a parked vintage automobile atop the rise.
